issues.legal_issue: Circumstances showing a right to defend property, despite recklessly excessive force that does not qualify for the applicable exception to murder, may warrant commutation of a death sentence.
material_facts: The appeal was limited to the sentences imposed after the appellants were convicted of four murders and sentenced to death.
The appellants were in effective physical possession of the disputed land and the crop when the opposing group arrived.
The opposing group was armed and intoxicated and had gone to remove the crop by force.
A fight occurred, and both sides sustained injuries; the injuries inflicted by the appellants on the deceased were much greater in number and severity than the injuries the appellants received.
The evidence did not rule out the participation of another person armed with a sharp-edged weapon.
The appellants had a right to defend their possession and property, but used recklessly excessive force.
issues.conclusion: The convictions were maintained, but each death sentence was commuted to imprisonment for life. The appellants were not entitled to the benefit of Exception II to Section 300 of the Indian Penal Code because their force was recklessly excessive; the circumstances showing their right of private defence of property could nevertheless be considered in deciding whether to impose the extreme penalty.
issues.legal_principle: The right of private defence of property and circumstances showing its exercise may be considered in sentencing even when the force used is recklessly excessive and Exception II to Section 300 of the Indian Penal Code therefore does not apply. No earlier cases are cited.

rule.if: capital_sentence_appeal_limited_to_sentence and defendants_in_effective_possession_of_property and opposing_group_armed_intoxicated_and_seeking_to_remove_property_by_force and both_sides_injured_in_a_fight and defendants_inflicted_far_greater_harm and defendants_used_recklessly_excessive_force and possibility_of_an_additional_attacker_not_excluded

predicates.capital_sentence_appeal_limited_to_sente: The convicted persons appealed against death sentences, and the appeal was limited to the sentences.
predicates.defendants_in_effective_possession_of_pr: The defendants were in effective physical possession of the property when the opposing group arrived.
predicates.opposing_group_armed_intoxicated_and_see: The opposing group arrived armed and intoxicated, intending to remove the property by force.
predicates.both_sides_injured_in_a_fight: A fight took place in which both the defendants and the opposing group sustained injuries.
predicates.defendants_inflicted_far_greater_harm: The defendants inflicted injuries on the opposing group that were much greater in number and severity than the injuries they received.
predicates.defendants_used_recklessly_excessive_for: The defendants used force recklessly in excess of what was needed to defend their possession and property.
predicates.possibility_of_an_additional_attacker_no: The evidence did not rule out the possibility that another person armed with a sharp-edged weapon participated in the assault.

issues.definition: When a sentence-only appeal follows a capital sentence and the defendants were defending property in their possession during an armed attempt to take it, the parties fought and were injured, the defendants caused far greater harm through recklessly excessive force, and another attacker was not ruled out, the death sentence is commuted to life imprisonment.
